Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Incoming reports from all corners of the Multiverse indicate the Machine Legion is sweeping across the planes, spreading their Phyrexian curse to all those unlucky enough to stand in their path! But all hope is not lost—many worlds remain defiant.

Support the resistance with these showcase treatments in stunning Halo Foil from New Capenna, Eldraine, Innistrad, Kaladesh, and Kaldheim featuring beautiful art by Samy Halim, Omar Rayyan, Samuel Araya, Warren Mahy, and Matt Stikker.

Contents:
• 1x Halo Foil Wheel and Deal
• 1x Halo Foil Questing Beast
• 1x Halo Foil Olivia Voldaren
• 1x Halo Foil Walking Ballista
• 1x Halo Foil The World Tree
